blocks.text: Match preview: Western Australia face England in Tour Match (ODI) on Sat, 7 Nov, 2026, 9:00 am at W.A.C.A. Ground Perth. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Mainly clear · High 27°C / Low 16°C · Rain: 0 mm · Wind: up to 17 km/h. Dry conditions expected — good for batting if the pitch is true.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
